project: Heavenly Faces Aesthetics: final non-ecommerce template copy
instructions:
Apply this Heavenly Faces Aesthetics copy to the existing non-ecommerce Mancino template at https://mancino-beauty-template.webflow.io/. Use exactly the twenty source routes listed in this document and JSON. The duplicated manicure URL in the supplied brief is one page.

This is a wording-only update. Preserve every existing font family, font weight, font size, line height, letter spacing, text transform and alignment, including tablet and mobile overrides. Keep each element’s actual styling; do not apply new global typography settings. Preserve colours, images, spacing, layouts, containers, components, heading tags, inline formatting, explicit line breaks, animations and page order.

Use each route, element class, source block order and supplied XPath to locate the corresponding wording. The JSON includes hashes of normalised source text. In a different local component structure, find the equivalent existing block. Change its text without rebuilding the element or flattening inline markup. Never adjust font sizes or spacing to force a sentence to fit.

Use the supplied copy exactly. Each rewritten block matches its source word count using whitespace-separated tokens; punctuation remains attached, while standalone symbols count as words. Apply repeated CMS replacements consistently throughout the listed pages and their shared navigation, category lists, service cards, product listings, review cards, forms and metadata. Preserve unchanged generic interface wording and vendor references where marked retain.

Use these service mappings throughout: hair styling becomes chemical peels; manicures becomes microneedling; makeup application becomes skin boosters; dermal fillers remains dermal fillers. Category names and supporting descriptions follow the products displayed in each collection: skincare, moisturisers and care, serums, and cleansing. Retain the existing routes in this copy pass, including their original slugs.

The header’s short brand label is Heavenly; the full business name is Heavenly Faces Aesthetics in the supplied main content and metadata. Short titles on product cards identify six previously observed Obagi products, with fuller identification in their descriptions. Do not transfer price fields or checkout copy from the previous ecommerce-template pack. This template pass adds neither product prices nor transactional functionality.

The old review cards contain clinic approach information rather than invented patient quotations. Keep their non-personal labels and the Our Approach heading. Replacements for staff grids describe care stages rather than fictional employees. Do not invent reviews, qualifications, clinical outcomes, opening hours, product benefits, discounts or treatment availability beyond the supplied facts.

Keep form submissions as enquiries, not appointment confirmations. Subscription wording is optional. Do not modify links, form handlers, consent logic, images or booking/shop integrations as part of a wording-only update. Flag the existing template image assets, contact destinations and consent-policy connections for the separate launch setup.

Only the twenty listed page bodies are covered. Product detail, article detail, individual review, treatment detail and type detail pages outside this list are not rewritten. Vendor documentation, alternative layout links and attribution remain technical references. Do not create new pages or alter routes.

Finally, verify word counts and check line wrapping at desktop and mobile widths. Equal word counts do not guarantee identical line breaks. Report overflow without changing the existing typography or design. No live website has been changed by this copy pack.
